_doc: Songs the hero can play (src/songs.py). Brandon writes songs as A Man Before a King; a song here is one of his, and its words are from his lyrics. Cooking the dish that names a song (its recipe's 'song'), or using the power that plays one, stops the soundtrack and plays the song once; its power lasts exactly as long as the song plays, timed in real seconds (seconds), then the soundtrack comes back. 'damage_taken' multiplies every blow and spell on the hero while it plays (Player.take_damage; starvation is not a blow); 'chain_mult' multiplies the right answers of a fight's maths chain (combat.effective_chain). 'power': the power that plays a song, its unlock ('streak': maths answers right in a row in one run; a wrong answer breaks it, the clock running out does not) and its 'cooldown' in turns (quirk_system). 'companion': who comes with the song and stays exactly as long as it plays ('dad': the Unusual Soul Sphere's Dad, game_combat._throw_unusual_sphere). 'label' is the effect's name on the sidebar and the character sheet. 'lines': 'start' when the song starts (the dish eaten, the power used), 'end' when it is over.

start: Caviar and tater tots: high and low on different plates, sitting at the same table tonight.
While the song plays, every blow and spell on you does half damage.
end: The song ends. Nobody saw this coming, but somehow everything's right.
Blows land at their full weight again.

start: "Math is cool." "Dad. Math is NOT cool." And I was like... yeah... so then I was like...
Every right answer counts double while it plays.
end: The song ends. "Okay... but can you help me with my homework now?"
Your right answers count as one link again.
